in_sanskrit.name: चारुदत्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who is given or bestowed with charm, grace, and beauty

in_hindi.name: चारुदत्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक जिससे चारुता रहता हुआ, चारुता दिया गया हुआ (one who is given or bestowed with charm, grace, and beauty)

in_tamil.name: சாருத்தத்தா
in_tamil.long_meaning: தரவான் ஜினம்பரிவர் அல்லவான் (one who is given or bestowed with charm, grace, and beauty)

in_telugu.name: చారుదద్ద
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేయియేయేయేయే (one who is given or bestowed with charm, grace, and beauty)

in_marathi.name: Charudatta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joyful to the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charudatta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charu means 'pleased, joyful' and Datta means 'given, offered'. Charudatta is a name that signifies being joyful to the gods and offering or giving them pleasure.

in_bengali.name: Charudatta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joyful to the Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Charudatta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Charu means 'pleased, joyful' and Datta means 'given, offered'. Charudatta is a name that signifies being joyful to the gods and offering or giving them pleasure.
